correctness.rationale: With exactly two nonoverlapping adjacent-pair deletions, a hitting set of output words H yields |C|<=|H| for a code with disjoint deletion balls. For n=5,6 output space gives size 2,4 transversals. At n=7,9 keep an output whose odd slots agree, by pigeonhole among original odd slots and pair each removed odd slot with distinct adjacent even indices; gives hitting sets 4 and 8. At n=8 the period-two H={0000,0101,1010,1111} meets every ball: repeated aligned binary pair case immediately and six complement/reversal orbit witnesses for 24 distinct-pair cases; independently enumerated all 256 input words. Period-two length n words have pairwise disjoint balls for n=6,7,8. The 3 generator rows for n=9 yield 8 binary codewords with output ball sizes 1,1,1,1,7,7,7,7 summing 32; independent output-set computation proves pairwise disjointness and union all 32 five-bit words. Exact maxima (2,4,4,4,8), perfect n=9. No n>=10 theorem.
